name: North Dakota
agency: North Dakota Department of Transportation (NDDOT), Driver License Division
permitAge: 14 (instruction permit; driver education required for younger applicants)

teen.holdPermit: 12 months if under 16; 6 months (or until 18) if 16 (NSC/IIHS summary)
teen.nightLimit: Restricted license: no driving 9 p.m. (or sunset if later) to 5 a.m., except work, school or religious events; lifts at 16 (secondary)
teen.phone: Under 18: no electronic communication device at all. All drivers: texting banned, $100 fine (NDDOT).

notes: Exam 25 questions, pass 80 percent (20 of 25) from third-party practice sites only; not confirmed by NDDOT.
Permit supervisor: licensed, at least 18, at least 3 years driving experience (secondary).
Restricted license from 15 (Vision Zero, NDCC 39-06-17); may drive only a parent's or guardian's vehicle (secondary).
Spanish manual 'Manual de Licencia de Conducir No Comercial' (2021-2023 edition, older than the English one) is listed on https://dot.nd.gov/node/5501; direct PDF URL not confirmed.
Knowledge test offered online in 14 languages (2022 report); Spanish not confirmed.
Move over: on multi-lane roads change lanes if safe, else slow down; since 2023 covers any stopped vehicle with flashing hazard lights. Fine figures conflict ($20/$50).
School bus: both directions stop unless on the opposite side of a highway divided by a physical median or barrier; fine reported raised to $250 (Valley News, 2026).
